name: infinition-site-scripts
description: Build scripts for infinition.github.io, run in CI. L'enrichissement ArtStation se lance en local, Cloudflare refusant les runners.

scripts.artstation: python scripts/collect-artstation.py infinition --out .artstation-raw.json && node scripts/build-artstation.mjs --user infinition --raw .artstation-raw.json --out data/artstation.json
